question: Which of the following schemes aims to provide generic medicines at reasonable prices to the citizen of the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Bharatiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Bharatiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) aims to provide quality medicines at affordable prices to the masses.
 
• It was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India.
 
• The scheme focuses on creating awareness about generic medicines and reducing the healthcare cost of citizens.
 
• Under PMBJP, dedicated outlets known as Pradhan Mantri Bharatiya Janaushadhi Kendras are established to sell generic medicines.
 
• These Kendras provide medicines that are equivalent in quality and efficacy to expensive branded drugs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Generic Medicines**:

 
 
• Generic medicines are drugs that are comparable to brand-name drugs in dosage form, strength, route of administration, quality, and performance characteristics.
 
• They are typically sold at lower prices than branded medicines.
 
• The use of generic medicines can significantly reduce healthcare costs for both individuals and healthcare systems.
 
 
 
• **Implementation and Reach**:
 
 
• As of the latest data, there are over 7,500 Janaushadhi Kendras across India.
 
• The scheme has been implemented in almost every state and Union Territory, ensuring wide accessibility.
 
 
 
• **Objective**:
 
 
• The primary objective of PMBJP is to ensure availability of quality medicines at affordable prices.
 
• It also aims to create awareness about the efficacy of generic medicines among the public.
 
 
 
• **Quality Assurance**:
 
 
• The medicines sold at Janaushadhi Kendras are tested for quality assurance in NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories) accredited laboratories.
 
• This ensures that the medicines are safe and effective for use.
